name: NUTTERX-MD
description: WhatsApp bot powered by Baileys with a separate pairing website. WhatsApp authentication is stored in Heroku PostgreSQL to survive restarts.

SESSION_ID.description: Your NUTTERX~ session ID generated by the separate pairing website. Required for the first database setup if no session is already stored.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only (e.g. 2547XXXXXXXX). Comma-separate multiple numbers.

MODE.description: public (everyone can use commands) or private (owner only).

PREFIX.description: The command prefix used by the bot.

ANTIDELETE.description: Enable or disable the AntiDelete feature.
